description:
Read a watch list with its `access_key` ('wk_...', from create_property_watch or the dashboard link after
        '#k='). Without `watch_id`: every watched property with its status, last check and unseen event count. With
        `watch_id`: that property's events, newest first: kind (deed_recorded, mortgage_recorded, lien_recorded,
        lis_pendens_recorded, owner_changed, violation_new, tax_sale_listed, surplus_listed, court_case, ...), severity
        (high / medium / low / info), title, date, official source link. People's names are initials.
name: list_property_watch_events
